issues.issue: [fixed] Supplementary revenue schedule left out of detail[] (notes call it a gross-to-net build-up). The rules want every line from supplementary schedules in detail[], with the deductions as negative lines and a detail_totals entry of 39,935,718. Adding it would not double count, because detail is kept apart from receipts. The page's own arithmetic holds (48,822,392 - 129,222 - 8,757,452 = 39,935,718).
Could be government grants (federal grants or intergovernmental/state aid) rather than private gifts. The page doesn't say; the extractor flagged it for review.

This column also holds employee benefits (4,436,329 per the p3 statement; 13,838,592 + 4,436,329 = 18,274,921) and purchased services, so 'supplies and materials' overstates supplies. A judgment call; the notes mention it.
